verses.transcription: min kulli shaytaanin wa jinin wa bashar
bihi ahuuzu min hawaaya wal lahiin
wa min jamiihil muuziyaati kulla hiin

verses.text: لَكَ الْوَرَى يَارَبِّ هَبْ لِى عِصْمَهْ
verses.transcription: lakal waraa yaa rabbi hab lii hismah
minhum wa min kulli balan wa niqmah

verses.text: هَبْ لِىَ مَآ أُحِبُّ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ
verses.transcription: hab liya maa uhibbu fid daarayni

verses.text: نَجِّ جَنَابِى مِنْ جَمِيعَ مَا يَسُو
verses.transcription: najji janaabii min jamiiha maa yasuu
hannis rifil ahdaa-a turran bin nabii

verses.text: أَنْتَ الَّذِى تَعْصِمُ مَنْ بِكَ اعْتَصَمْ
verses.transcription: antal lazii tahsimu man bikah tasam

verses.text: مِنْ كُلِّ مَا يَؤُمُّهُ مِنَ النِّقَمْ
verses.transcription: min kulli maa ya-ummuhu minan niqam

verses.text: وَكُلُّ مَنْ لَّكَ الْتَجَا لَا يُرْفَضُ
verses.transcription: wa kullu man lakal tajaa laa yurfadu
wa qaytanii yaa barru kufran faqinii
yaa barru kun liya walaa tukhjilnii
dunyaa wa ukhraa wa tajawaz hannii
lil mustafak tubis salaatan was salaam

bayts.text: حَمِدْتُّ مَنْ يَّعِصِمُنِى مِنَ الضَّرَرْ ۞ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَجِنٍ وَبَشَرْ

translations.it.karamati: Ho lodato Colui che mi preserva dal danno di ogni demonio, jinn e uomo.
translations.en.karamati: I have praised Him Who guards me from the harm of every devil, jinn and human.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai loué Celui qui me préserve du mal de tout démon, djinn et homme.

bayts.text: سُبْحَانهُ رَبًّا حَفِيظًا أَحْتَمِى ۞ بِحِفْظِهِ مِنَ الْبَلَا والنِّقَمِ

translations.it.karamati: Gloria a Lui, Signore e Custode: mi riparo nella Sua custodia dalla sventura e dai castighi.
translations.en.karamati: Glory be to Him, Lord and Preserver: I shelter in His keeping from affliction and punishments.
translations.fr.karamati: Gloire à Lui, Seigneur et Gardien : je m'abrite dans Sa garde contre le malheur et les châtiments.

bayts.text: بِهِ أَعُوذُ مِنْ هَوَاىَ وَاللَّعِينْ ۞ وَمِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمُوذِيَاتِ كُلَّ عِينْ

translations.it.karamati: In Lui mi rifugio dalla mia passione e dal Maledetto, e da tutte le (creature) nocive, da ogni malocchio.
translations.en.karamati: In Him I take refuge from my passion and from the Accursed, and from all harmful (creatures), from every evil eye.
translations.fr.karamati: En Lui je me réfugie de ma passion et du Maudit, et de toutes les (créatures) nuisibles, de tout mauvais œil.

bayts.text: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أَدْعُوَهُ مُسْتَشْفِعَا ۞ بِجَاهِ حِبِّهِ شَفِيعِ الشُّفَعَآ

translations.it.karamati: Ho inteso invocarLo chiedendo intercessione per il rango del Suo amato, intercessore degli intercessori,
translations.en.karamati: I have intended to call upon Him seeking intercession by the rank of His beloved, the intercessor of intercessors,
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai eu l'intention de L'invoquer en demandant l'intercession par le rang de Son bien-aimé, intercesseur des intercesseurs,

bayts.text: أَحْمَدُ سَيِّدَ الْوَرَى مُصَلِّيَا ۞ عَلَيْهِ ذَا تَوَسُولٍ لِّرَبِّيَا

translations.it.karamati: Aḥmad, signore delle creature, benedicendolo, (io) che cerco per mezzo suo l'accesso al mio Signore.
translations.en.karamati: Aḥmad, master of creatures, blessing him, (I) who seek through him access to my Lord.
translations.fr.karamati: Aḥmad, seigneur des créatures, en le bénissant, (moi) qui cherche par lui l'accès à mon Seigneur.

bayts.text: أَسْأَلُ رَبِّىَ بِجَاهِهِ النَّجَاةْ ۞ مِنَ الرَّزَايَا وَتَنَازُعِ الْبُغَاةْ

translations.it.karamati: Chiedo al mio Signore, per il suo rango, la salvezza dalle sventure e dalla contesa degli oppressori.
translations.en.karamati: I ask my Lord, by his rank, for deliverance from misfortunes and from the strife of oppressors.
translations.fr.karamati: Je demande à mon Seigneur, par son rang, le salut contre les malheurs et la querelle des oppresseurs.

bayts.text: لَكَ الْوَرَى يَارَبِّ هَبْ لِى عِصْمَهْ ۞ مِنْهُمْ وَمِنْ كُلِّ بَلًا وَنِقْمَهْ

translations.it.karamati: A Te (appartengono) le creature, o Signore: donami una preservazione da esse e da ogni sventura e castigo.
translations.en.karamati: To You (belong) the creatures, O Lord: grant me protection from them and from every affliction and punishment.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi (appartiennent) les créatures, ô Seigneur : donne-moi une préservation contre elles et contre tout malheur et châtiment.

bayts.text: لَكَ جَعَلْتُ يَاحَفِيظُ نَفْسِى ۞ وَدِيعَةً فَأَنْتَ دَأْبًا أُنْسِى

translations.it.karamati: A Te, o Custode (Al-Ḥafīẓ), ho affidato la mia anima in deposito: Tu sei sempre la mia intimità.
translations.en.karamati: To You, O Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), I have entrusted my soul as a deposit: You are ever my intimacy.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi, ô Gardien (Al-Ḥafīẓ), j'ai confié mon âme en dépôt : Tu es toujours mon intimité.

bayts.text: هَبْ لِىَ مَآ أُحِبُّ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ ۞ وَفِيهِمَا اعْصِمْنِى مِنَ الْعَارَيْنِ

translations.it.karamati: Donami ciò che amo nelle due Dimore, e in esse preservami dalle due onte.
translations.en.karamati: Grant me what I love in the two Abodes, and in them guard me from the two disgraces.
translations.fr.karamati: Donne-moi ce que j'aime dans les deux Demeures, et en elles préserve-moi des deux opprobres.

bayts.text: وَجَّهْتُ وَاجْهِىَ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ ۞ مَعَ وَسِيلَتِى وَذَاكَ حَسْبِى

translations.it.karamati: Ho rivolto il mio volto a Te, Signore, insieme al mio mezzo d'accesso (il Profeta), e ciò mi basta.
translations.en.karamati: I have turned my face to You, Lord, together with my means of access (the Prophet), and that suffices me.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai tourné mon visage vers Toi, Seigneur, avec mon moyen d'accès (le Prophète), et cela me suffit.

bayts.text: نَجِّ جَنَابِى مِنْ جَمِيعَ مَا يَسُو ۞ وَعَنِّىَ اكْفِ كُلَّ مَا يُوَسْوِسُ

translations.it.karamati: Salva la mia persona da tutto ciò che affligge, e tieni lontano da me tutto ciò che insinua.
translations.en.karamati: Save my person from all that grieves, and keep from me all that whispers.
translations.fr.karamati: Sauve ma personne de tout ce qui afflige, et éloigne de moi tout ce qui insinue.

bayts.text: عَنِّى اصْرِفِ الْأَعْدَآءَ طُرًّا بِالنَّبِى ۞ وَأَهْلِ بَدْرٍ الْكِرَامِ النُّجُبِ

translations.it.karamati: Allontana da me i nemici, tutti, per mezzo del Profeta e della gente di Badr, i nobili, gli eletti.
translations.en.karamati: Turn the enemies away from me, all of them, through the Prophet and the people of Badr, the noble, the elect.
translations.fr.karamati: Éloigne de moi les ennemis, tous, par le Prophète et les gens de Badr, les nobles, les élus.

bayts.text: مُنَّ عَلَىَّ بِالدُّخُولِ سَاكِنَا ۞ فِى حِصْنِكَ الْحَصِيرِ مِنْهُمْ ءَامِنَا

translations.it.karamati: Concedimi di entrare, dimorando tranquillo, nella Tua fortezza inespugnabile, al sicuro da loro.
translations.en.karamati: Grant me to enter, dwelling at peace, into Your impregnable fortress, safe from them.
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde-moi d'entrer, demeurant tranquille, dans Ta forteresse imprenable, en sécurité contre eux.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الَّذِى تَعْصِمُ مَنْ بِكَ اعْتَصَمْ ۞ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا يَؤُمُّهُ مِنَ النِّقَمْ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che preservi chi in Te si stringe da ogni castigo che lo prende di mira.
translations.en.karamati: You are He Who guards whoever holds fast to You from every punishment that aims at him.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui préserves celui qui s'attache à Toi de tout châtiment qui le vise.

bayts.text: لَكَ أُمُورِى أَبَدًا أُفَوِّضُ ۞ وَكُلُّ مَنْ لَّكَ الْتَجَا لَا يُرْفَضُ

translations.it.karamati: A Te affido per sempre le mie faccende, e chiunque si rifugi in Te non è respinto.
translations.en.karamati: To You I entrust my affairs forever, and whoever takes refuge in You is not turned away.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi je remets pour toujours mes affaires, et quiconque se réfugie en Toi n'est pas repoussé.

bayts.text: وَقَيْتَنِى يَابَرُّ كُفْرًا فَقِنِى ۞ ضَرَرَ أَهْلِهِ وَكُلَّ فِتَنِ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai preservato, o Benefico (Al-Barr), dalla miscredenza: preservami dunque dal danno dei suoi seguaci e da ogni tentazione.
translations.en.karamati: You have guarded me, O Beneficent (Al-Barr), from disbelief: so guard me from the harm of its people and from every trial.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as préservé, ô Bienfaisant (Al-Barr), de la mécréance : préserve-moi donc du mal de ses partisans et de toute tentation.

bayts.text: كُفَّ أَكُفَّ الْمُشْرِكِينَ عَنِّى ۞ بِأَهْلِ بَدْرٍ وَاجْعَلَنْهُمْ حِصْنِى

translations.it.karamati: Trattieni da me le mani degli associatori, per mezzo della gente di Badr, e fa' di loro la mia fortezza.
translations.en.karamati: Hold back from me the hands of the associators, through the people of Badr, and make them my fortress.
translations.fr.karamati: Retiens loin de moi les mains des associateurs, par les gens de Badr, et fais d'eux ma forteresse.

bayts.text: يَابَرُّ كُنْ لِّىَ وَلَا تُخْجِلْنِى ۞ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى وَتَجَوَزْ عَنِّى

translations.it.karamati: O Benefico, sii per me e non coprirmi di vergogna, in questo mondo e nell'altro, e passa oltre (le mie colpe).
translations.en.karamati: O Beneficent, be for me and do not put me to shame, in this world and the next, and pass over (my faults).
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Bienfaisant, sois pour moi et ne me couvre pas de honte, en ce monde et dans l'autre, et passe outre (mes fautes).

bayts.text: لِلْمُصْطَفَى اكْتُبِ الصَّلَاةً وَالسَّلَامْ ۞ بِئَالِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ عَلَى دَوَامْ

translations.it.karamati: Per l'Eletto scrivi la benedizione e il saluto, con la sua Famiglia e i suoi Compagni, in perpetuo.
translations.en.karamati: For the Chosen One write blessing and peace, with his Family and his Companions, in perpetuity.
translations.fr.karamati: Pour l'Élu écris la bénédiction et le salut, avec sa Famille et ses Compagnons, à perpétuité.
